call_encoding.omitted: Executable paths, process identities and duplicate raw stdout/stderr. Original complete call files remain identified by SHA256.
call_encoding.reconstruct_payload: Merge science_by_cell[call.cell] with artifact=call.arm, build_ns=call.build_ns and elapsed_ns=call.elapsed_ns.
call_encoding.retained: All 840 call positions, native timer values, process start/end clocks, return codes and stdout/stderr hashes; all paired block and host aggregates.
call_encoding.science: Each run stores all payload fields except artifact/build_ns/elapsed_ns once per cell. Exact equality was checked for every call.

independent_reconstruction.arithmetic_comparison: Read-only reconstruction from integer native timings with independent geometric-mean, allowance and host-median calculations. Float aggregates agree within 2e-13 relative or 1e-15 seconds absolute; no scientific tolerance was changed.

panel_report.scope: Allocation join only; the independent reports retain their separate decisions.

configuration.budget_scope: Both sequential patch runs share a 7200s allocation cap; bounded cleanup follows.
configuration.decision: Both endpoints use host-median intervals on Linux; all Mac results descriptive. Adverse pairs retained without separate veto; no retries or automatic adoption.
configuration.science_contract: Preserve exact input/science signatures, iterations, maximum_error, recurrence_residual, explicit_apply_calls, dimensions and derived work/shape fields within each arm and across base/patch. Timers/artifact labels are excluded. Keep finite fitted-error<=1e-8 and fullsolve zero-demeaned<=1e-8 witnesses, convergence, no unidentified columns/warnings, and exact internal group repeats. Reuse the owners full-vector/integer/weighted/slope witnesses; FNV64 timing signatures are not cryptographic proof of every coefficient bit.
configuration.scope: The held sparse back-substitution optimization is absent from both pairs and remains held. These independent optional optimizations do not qualify beta.11 or authorize an upstream write.

counts.limitations: Both fields protected separately. Six Linux host medians yield min/max exact bounds, no simultaneous coverage. All Mac costs descriptive. Adverse pairs retained without a separate veto. No resampling, adoption or upstream writes.

attempts.failure: Sandbox denied sysctl hw before host admission or any measured-plan native call.
Strict host admission observed three competing Stata processes and stopped before any local preflight or timed call.

claude_binding_assessment.limitation: This is evidence only at the saved sample. It does not establish present identities. A restart or new unbound Claude would receive no exemption; any proposed new bindings require a separately authorized fresh census/review and new plan hashes.
claude_binding_assessment.reason: The second saved admission sample observed every bound PID/start/ucomm/command-hash unchanged, and the competitors were Stata, not an unbound Claude identity. The strict monitor requires no census refresh for an otherwise identical operational retry.

macos.no_discarded_timing_rationale: Each launch completed its 28-call prior science panel without --measure; all native timers were null. The first stopped at a denied hardware query; the second stopped at initial host admission. Neither started a measured-plan native call. Resource observations are not native performance timings.
macos.operational_context: Parent separately identified an ongoing MC driver with three jobs. No unrelated project files were inspected and no process was stopped by this assessment.
macos.scope: Two operational Mac launch failures for independent counts/scatter comparisons; no performance result or adoption decision.

scope: Independent frozen-base comparisons for the dense-count and categorical-scatter patches. This is not the beta.11 versus beta.10 plugin qualification.

statistical_rule.classification: Passed if upper <= 0; regression if lower > 0; otherwise inconclusive. Either unresolved endpoint requires review. Adverse individual blocks are retained without a separate veto.
statistical_rule.linux_unit: For each endpoint, take the median of two block excesses per physical host. Six hosts give the exact min/max median bounds at one-sided alpha 0.025 under the declared unit assumptions.
statistical_rule.mirrored_block: Two observations per arm in mirrored order. Compute each arm geometric mean; ratio is patch/base; excess seconds is patch - base - max(0.05*base,0.001).
